au pilori.", "sha256": "23b7b50a8dbdc65c139a44c665df8b6292acc651e647a29bf6726d8f418a5fb0", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1950], "source_xml_sha256": "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0124", "text": "—Le pilori mène à la potence.", "sha256": "7e7771ce8c5c360957000bfba406bf26f3aa5debc5d4678156d235e3088ac0c4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0125", "text": "—La potence est une balance qui a un homme à un bout et toute la terre à l'autre. Il est beau d'être l'homme.", "sha256": "bdaded97c28c5a8c18a9827aaf2f06f9299cc46f41ca0e6c164f1f57191b0e6d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1953], "source_xml_sha256": à l'enfer.", "sha256": "7e92296187c8fe83277a7a30cd845e71f58ca05229dfa20807e50bfb83564bae", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1954], "source_xml_sha256": feu.", "sha256": "1e8a83457c0d45358167519359aa6694796ddefcdd244a010c88ec9c17d7cb17", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1955], "source_xml_sha256": la fin sera mauvaise.", "sha256": "dead6c504782194771ea9733f8c5380370a7d88df5dd7c3953435a0e634cb4c3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1956], "source_xml_sha256": aura été bon.»", "sha256": "24b7b86ffbf67bc1e6e64bc31bbdbb0955dd2cb6b1fbf2d4543e0a639a027798", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1957], "source_xml_sha256": "070a14f41e2c5be7b29613df1b9a3a2443d9c9d903f0d58260f65785983e1e41", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0130", "text": "En ce moment le bruit d'un pas se fit entendre dans l'escalier.", "sha256": "f251974934e211737577f548db0b9ae3a9b34d616e931069ba98a9a501b3ff13", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1958], "source_xml_sha256": "efecc5c3338064f6f1d7c042ded2de74b33fbd57ba9f2c0d275e35d9bc80e93a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0131", "text": "«Silence! dit l'archidiacre en mettant un doigt sur sa bouche, voici maître Jacques. Écoutez, Jehan, ajouta-t-il à voix basse, gardez-vous de parler jamais de ce que vous aurez vu et entendu ici. Cachez-vous vite sous ce fourneau, et ne soufflez pas.»", "sha256": "fefb66044bd4f463e950bbefe56c500f4aa6b914fca3a724b5e7c15ae838cd33", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1959], "source_xml_sha256": "07cac4a26ee2a4c92119fa8bd2805459dee693447fc96987ced7d1ebfefe1114", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0132", "text": "L'écolier se blottit sous le fourneau. Là, il lui vint une idée féconde.", "sha256": "14eebc5378c287e5a5465072f122a48cdf63c155be9161991b3ff81fb892c53d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1960], "source_xml_sha256": "f2c67089a7ee99851ec0aa03bbcd9cbe283752959cf98b13d5e797186ac61b9f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0133", "text": "«À propos, frère Claude, un florin pour que je ne souffle pas.", "sha256": "be3442a24cd61cc052b0ef9ac2a95d4cf65dbebcc1f1c9aae52b322c0f767a03", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1961], "source_xml_sha256": "af4698a5e3dbefa2400d104e851bcd1d115121a4e958ea0a2ba619d40aa97e60", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0134", "text": "—Silence! je vous le promets.", "sha256": "a39831d9882ba9a0fe80b4f13becc1d94a4537f4e08e5bb1a7abf9c157732f5d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1962], "source_xml_sha256": "698236286d922dabc40ea2c0e0b5d02afc19c6d43836f16e1ba8872d8a95f179", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0135", "text": "—Il faut me le donner.", "sha256": "1410ede43107d4b455eb77a24d68b3f8fdb73d51b4f6a3681196393aead53f04", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1963], "source_xml_sha256": "f19329ec77d86db6d141f1bb89a3b90385d49854a33e5392e83ee55d4f52f2ef", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0136", "text": "—Prends donc!» dit l'archidiacre en lui jetant avec colère son escarcelle.", "sha256": "e62f3eee5a9273320d45a3b0091f8f5762ebd1f16d1f5d8c4f2221664ba203ef", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1964], "source_xml_sha256": "26d1902ea8b31967436dc6f17b2346ca8103f650f3a7d9102358ee7df738cce5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u034-b0137", "text": "Jehan se renfonça sous le fourneau, et la porte s'ouvrit.", "sha256": "3dd7e1312800fa932253a80f42e0b91ce92003d7a05cb0334c74e591cd685d33", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [1965], "source_xml_sha256": "fe9f22ee6a8c02ebc2690fe5fcc35848780b725b0b0bccf3eb5a8490402b6988", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
